messages:
Jian: heads-up, ran the mixed-quant rollout on canary, seeing structured output fields drop in a small fraction of requests. example attached below.
Priya: ugh, which combo? int4 + fp8? or full int8?
Jian: int4 for most layers, fp8 for attention kernels. batching heuristics = dynamic (adaptive). KV cache enabled.
Marco: can you paste the failing output? small snippet is fine.
Jian: 
Jian: ```json
Jian: {
Jian:   "response": {
Jian:     "items": [ { "id": 1, "name": "alpha" } ],
Jian:     "summary": null
Jian:   }
Jian: }
Jian: ```
Jian: summary used to be a string, now it's null ~0.8% of feeds.
Aisha: that smells like truncation / early stop in decoder top-k. any clues in logs?
Jian: profiler shows occasional token-level NMAD spikes during KV read: big latency thunk at layers ~30-38.
perf-bot: perf report: canary batch=8, avg RT = 86ms (baseline fp32 120ms), throughput +1.4x. QoE regression: eval delta summary score -6.2% on schema tests, hallucination rate +3.1%.
Priya: interesting: perf win but quality hit. Could be quantization scale mismatch for KV cached keys across mixed kernels.
Marco: I pulled a trace. snippet from runtime log: 
Marco: ```
Marco: [2026-03-12 11:22:13] kernel_select: chosen=int4_attention_fast for layers 1-29
Marco: [2026-03-12 11:22:13] kernel_select: chosen=fp8_attention_stable for layers 30-40
Marco: [2026-03-12 11:22:13] kv_cache: read_batch: dtype=uint8, shape=(8, 128, 1024)
Marco: [2026-03-12 11:22:13] quant_merge: applied per-tensor scale mismatch detected at layer=34
Marco: ```
Aisha: per-tensor vs per-channel scaling mismatch would definitely corrupt interpolation when merging caches between kernels.
Jian: repro steps I've been using: 
Jian: 1) checkout quant-mix-kernel branch
Jian: 2) calibrate with 5000 random sequences: `tools/calib --tokens 5000 --per-channel true`
Jian: 3) start server with `--kv-cache enabled --adaptive-batching`
Jian: 4) run schema-eval harness: `eval/schema_runner --profile canary`
Jian: I can share dump if helpful.
Priya: try forcing calibration to per-channel and see if mismatch disappears. also try disabling adaptive batching to rule out cross-request mix.
Marco: I started an experiment: per-channel calib + binding fp8 kernels to attention only + force int4 everywhere else. preliminary: schema delta -2.1% (improved), halluc +0.5%.
perf-bot: perf diff for Marco's run: RT 92ms, throughput +1.3x relative to baseline.
Aisha: good signal. suggests the issue is scale alignment at kernel boundaries and when reusing KV cache across different kernel implementations.
Priya: another angle: when KV entries are stored as quantized bytes, do we record the scale/zero-point per-cache-entry? if not, reconstruct can be inconsistent.
Marco: checked code: KV cache stores raw quantized buffer + header with scale for that chunk, but header only exists for fp8 path; int4 path was assuming unified runtime scale metadata — bug!
Jian: that explains intermittent null fields: cache read misinterprets float representation, decoder emits <=0 tokens and then stops structure generation.
Aisha: mitigation options (short list):
Aisha: 1) short-term: force homogeneous kernel choice for all attention layers (disable mixing) for canary.
Aisha: 2) mid-term: attach explicit per-chunk scale metadata for int4 path + compatibility layer on read.
Aisha: 3) long-term: unify quant metadata schema across kernels and add verifiers in KV read path.
Priya: + add a runtime check that validates dequant round-trip on cache restore in debug builds.
Marco: I can push a hotfix that adds an assert and fallback to dequant->requant with correct scale if mismatch detected. small perf hit but safe.
Jian: please do. we should gate canary rollout until fallback is in place.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: branch=hotfix/kv-quant-meta, env=canary, user=Marco
deploy-bot: deployment started (canary)
Marco: pushed hotfix. running smoke: 200 schema requests, zero schema-null regressions observed.
perf-bot: post-hotfix stats: schema delta -0.4% (stat noise), hallucination +0.1%, RT 95ms.
Aisha: looks acceptable to re-enable gradual rollout but keep tight alerting on schema-eval and hallucination metrics.
Priya: next steps:
Priya: - PR for metadata schema and tests (assign Marco)
Priya: - add debug roundtrip assert & opt-out flag (assign Jian)
Priya: - perf regression benchmark across batch sizes (assign Perf team)
Aisha: I'll open an incident-lite doc and tag SRE on alerting thresholds.
Jian: thanks all — good triage. I'll add reproducer to the ticket and link evaluation diffs.
Marco: cc @perf-bot – please keep running the nightly mixed-quant suites with KV on/off combos.
perf-bot: acknowledged. nightly runs will include kv-on/kv-off matrix and per-layer scale drift telemetry.
Priya: nice work. :thumbsup:
